==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I had a vision of another reality of elf-like godly beings with colorful skin and silver mohawks. They live inside of clocks underneath a glowing kaleidoscopic sky. They seemed to be aware of the fact that I was watching them.

The elf gods summoned warriors from other worlds to fight for the fate of the multiverse. Some of the gods took these battles more seriously than others. There was an obvious tension between them.

I could feel my physical body in the waking world bound by some magnetic force. This force seemed to want to keep me locked inside of the vision. When I finally woke up at midnight, it felt as if my eyes were vibrating and as if I had broken through some invisible barrier.

When I went back to sleep, I found myself constantly dreaming about reversing the polarity of a disintegrator device to retrofit it into some kind of teleporter.
